prompt:
We're running FounderAssistBot, an AI-powered personal assistant for our CEO on Telegram. After each completed session, the bot needs to send a closing message with smart interactive options so the founder can quickly choose what to do next.

A session just wrapped up — the details are in `conversation_log.json` in the workspace. The founder was working on an administrative and planning task during the afternoon.

Please generate the outgoing bot message payload and save it as `bot_response.json`. The payload should include the reply text from the conversation log and the appropriate set of quick-action options for the founder to tap. Make sure the options are right for the time of day shown in the session data.

Refer to the skill documentation available in the workspace to understand exactly how the payload must be structured.
